skill_name: Create a modified version of the following recipe that only takes 15 minutes to prepare:
workflow:
Quick Lasagna
- 2 cups of cooked lasagna noodles 
- 1/2 cup ricotta cheese 
- 2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 
- 2 tablespoons of grated parmesan cheese 
- 1 tablespoon of olive oil 
- 1 small onion, diced 
- 2 cloves of garlic, minced 
- 2 (26 oz) jars of spaghetti sauce 
- 1/2 teaspoon of dried oregano 
- 1/4 teaspoon of dried thyme 

In a small skillet, heat the olive oil over low-medium heat. Sautée the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Add the spaghetti sauce and herbs and simmer for 10
